name: stock-forward-tof-bench-v1
reference: Horizontal distance from the target surface to the front window of the forward ToF sensor on the top module, measured with a tape and the aircraft level on a stand. Motors stay off.

blocks.note: Bare whiteboard next to the target print, beam perpendicular to the board.
A spare cup print taped flat at beam height so the beam lands on the printed cup.
A sheet printed solid black, taped flat at beam height.
Rotate the aircraft about its vertical axis; keep the sensor window over the same mark.
Point the sensor at empty space with nothing within 3 m; expect out-of-range replies.
Hold a card about 3 cm in front of the sensor window.
